White Chocolate Caramel Snowman Hands
By: Culinary Envy
Published: Thursday, December 1, 2016 - 12:49pm

Ingredients




40 caramels
20 honey wheat braided pretzel twists
3 oz melted white chocolate
Sprinkles and crushed candy canes

Preparation

1 Microwave the unwrapped caramels on high just until softened, only about 10-15 seconds. It should only be warm to the touch (be careful). 2 Using your hands, mold two softened caramels around the lower half of each braided pretzel to resemble a snowman arm and hand. 3 Dip in melted white chocolate and allow the excess to drip off. Place the leg on waxed paper, sprinkle on toppings and let sit until set.

About

Yummy 3 ingredient White Chocolate Caramel Snowman Hands Holiday dessert. Put a Smile on everyone’s face, including Santa’s!
